title: LangGraph Server not propagating Runtime Context when using SendAPI
author: LouisAuneau

comments.author: LouisAuneau
comments.body: For people seeing this issue. It turns out that if in my case it wasn't related to the sendAPI at all. But when I invoked my assistant through the `langgraph-sdk`, and then hit an `interrupt`. I was resuming my graph from LangGraph Studio, which resets the context to `None`, while I should have resumed from the SDK and provide the context again.
